name: Female: Delete Voice
source:
One winter morning, Akane had an urgent need to pee.
Of course someone would catch it on camera. In this case it was Sudo,
her classmate, who threatened to make it public... unless...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE186735.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个冬天的早晨，茜迫切需要小便。
当然有人会用相机捕捉到这一点。在这种情况下是须藤，
她的同学，威胁要公开……除非……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE186735.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
